test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Humans have been practicing water harvesting since ancient times. Some different forms of water harvesting structures are given in Column I and the place they are practiced in Column II. Select the option that shows the correct matching.

 
 

 
 
 
**Column I**

 
**(Water harvesting structures)**

 
 
 
 
**Column II**

 
(Places where they are practiced)<
solution:
The correct answer is** '__(____A) - (iii), (B) - (i), (C)- (iv), (D) - (ii)__'.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Surangams are used in Kerala**, a system that provides a reliable supply of water for irrigation.
 
• **The Pyne system is used in Bihar,** it is an indigenous irrigation technology system used in South Bihar.
 
• **Khadin is used in Rajasthan,** based on the principle of rainwater harvesting on farmland.
 
• **Kulhs is a traditional water harvesting system in Himachal Pradesh, **the water flowing through the streams is diverted into manmade channels.
